places.name: Medina of Sfax
places.ai_summary: The Medina of Sfax is a well-preserved historic area, showcasing traditional Tunisian architecture and vibrant local markets.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Explore the souks for unique handicrafts and local delicacies.

places.name: Sfax Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The Sfax Archaeological Museum offers a glimpse into the rich history of the region, with artifacts from the Roman, Byzantine, and Islamic periods.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Roman mosaics and the ancient pottery collections.

places.name: Kasbah of Sfax
places.ai_summary: The Kasbah of Sfax is a historic fortress with impressive architecture, offering panoramic views of the city and the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top of the Kasbah for a breathtaking view of the medina and the coast.

places.name: Bab Diwan Gate
places.ai_summary: Bab Diwan is the grand entrance to the Medina of Sfax, featuring impressive architecture and intricate decorations.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Take a moment to admire the detailed carvings and the massive wooden doors.

places.name: Great Mosque of Sfax
places.ai_summary: The Great Mosque of Sfax is a historic mosque known for its impressive minaret and beautiful Islamic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Non-Muslim visitors should dress modestly and may be asked to leave during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and take time to appreciate the intricate tile work and carvings.

places.name: Dar Jallouli Museum
places.ai_summary: Dar Jallouli Museum is a cultural institution housed in a beautiful palace, featuring exhibits on the history and culture of Sfax.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Check out the traditional Tunisian clothing and the impressive collection of coins.

places.name: Sfax Fishing Port
places.ai_summary: The Sfax Fishing Port is a bustling harbor area where visitors can see traditional fishing boats and enjoy fresh seafood.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning to see the fish market.

places.place_tip: Try the local specialty, grilled fish, at one of the portside restaurants.

places.name: Sfax Old City Walls
places.ai_summary: The Sfax Old City Walls are historic fortifications that once protected the city, offering a glimpse into the past.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunset when the walls are illuminated.

places.place_tip: Walk along the walls for a unique perspective of the city and the sea.
places.address: Sfax Old City Walls, Sfax, Tunisia

places.ai_summary: Place de la République is a central square in Sfax, known for its modernist architecture and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: A great place to relax and people-watch.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes and shops for a taste of local life.

places.name: Habib Bourguiba Avenue
places.ai_summary: Habib Bourguiba Avenue is a major thoroughfare in Sfax, lined with palm trees, shops, and cafes, and is perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: A popular spot for both locals and tourists.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee or mint tea at one of the terrace cafes.

places.name: Kerkennah Islands Ferry
places.ai_summary: The Kerkennah Islands Ferry provides access to the picturesque Kerkennah Islands, known for their beautiful beaches and seafood.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is recommended, especially in summer.

places.place_tip: Explore the islands by bike and enjoy a seafood lunch at a local restaurant.

places.name: Sfax Marina
places.ai_summary: Sfax Marina is a modern marina offering boat rentals, seafood restaurants, and a pleasant promenade for walking.

opening_hours.notes: A great place for a leisurely walk and to enjoy fresh seafood.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacy, squid ink pasta, at one of the marina restaurants.

places.ai_summary: Souk des Etoffes is a vibrant market in Sfax, famous for its colorful textiles, traditional clothing, and local handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and enjoy the lively atmosphere of the market.

places.place_tip: Bring your camera for breathtaking photos of the city and the coast.
